status: Upstream elekloader core-ar2 0.3 for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74 (the core-ar2-v0.3 pre-release): the Digitakt mk1 core with the Rytm's addresses, plus mod storage. 0.3 is for OS 1.74 only.

events.name: ev_tick
events.when: the UI compose check, approximately 20 Hz
events.handler: void f(void *ctrl); set ctrl + 0x20 to 1 to request redraw; not an audio-rate clock

events.name: ev_draw
events.when: after the OS composes the screen
events.handler: void f(void *bmp, void *ctrl); y counts up from the bottom row (0) to the top (63)

events.name: ev_key
events.handler: int f(void *brain, void *event); nonzero consumes the event

events.name: ev_enc
events.handler: int f(void *brain, void *event); nonzero consumes the event

events.name: ev_render_in
events.when: entry of the ColdFire's 32-frame audio block, which renders the digital delay and reverb; the analog voices are not rendered here

events.name: ev_render_out
events.when: exit of the same audio block

events.name: ev_project
events.when: after CREATE NEW or the project reset (how 0), and after every project load, at boot too (how 1); the stored project and its mod data are in place
events.handler: void f(int how, unsigned dropped); dropped flags the global, track, pattern and project scopes that loaded as zeros; keep it short, and start no load or save from it

exports.name: core_additem
exports.purpose: Add a SETTINGS row from an ev_settings handler.

exports.name: core_store_get
exports.prototype: unsigned core_store_get(unsigned field, void *item, int index)
exports.purpose: Read a mod storage field (STORE(sym) from analog-rytm-mk2/store.h); interrupts are masked while it reads.

exports.name: core_store_set
exports.prototype: void core_store_set(unsigned field, void *item, int index, unsigned value)
exports.purpose: Write a mod storage field; interrupts are masked while it writes.

scopes.sound: 56 bits per sound, in its own spare bytes
scopes.track: 8 x T bits per pattern track (T starts at 2, at most 16 bits)
scopes.pattern: 8 x P bits per pattern (P starts at 4)
scopes.project: what the project's tagged store has left

storage.declare: build.storage: [{ sym, scope, bits }] (1 to 32 bits; sym is a C name). The linker places each field from the build's lockfile, as elekloader does, and carries the lockfile after the image.
